user.title: Connect to RailFeed
user.description: Create a free API key on your RailFeed account's API Keys page (railfeed.co.uk/api-keys) and enter it here. You'll choose your station by name on the next page.

station.title: Choose your station
station.description: Start typing a station name (or its three-letter code) and pick it from the list. If you only want trains that stop at a particular station, pick that one under "Only trains calling at".

data_description.station: The station whose departures you want, for example Belvedere.
data_description.calling_at: A station on the train's route, for example Abbey Wood. Only trains that stop there after your station are listed, whether or not it is their final destination. Add the same station again with a different choice here to track several destinations.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate RailFeed
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {station} was rejected. Enter a new key from railfeed.co.uk/api-keys.

error.invalid_station: RailFeed doesn't recognise that station. Pick one from the list or enter its three-letter code.
error.invalid_calling_at: Pick a station that RailFeed knows from the list (or enter its three-letter code), different from your station.
error.rate_limited: RailFeed rate limit reached. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: That station is already set up with that destination.

data.calling_at: Only trains calling at this station

data_description.scan_interval: Minimum 30. RailFeed's feeds don't update faster than that.
data_description.max_departures: How many upcoming departures to include in the 'departures' attribute.
data_description.passenger_only: Hides freight, empty stock and charters.
data_description.calling_at: Optional. A station on the train's route, for example Abbey Wood. Only trains that stop there after this station are listed, whether or not it is their final destination. Leave blank for all.
data_description.via: Optional. Up to 5 stations that tell routes apart, for example Greenwich and Lewisham. Start typing a name to find them. Trains calling at one of them get the word 'via' and the station name added to their destination, e.g. London Cannon Street via Greenwich. Leave blank for none.
data_description.destinations: Optional. Stations the train's final destination must be, for example King's Cross. Start typing a name to find them. Leave blank for all.

error.invalid_destinations: Pick stations from the list or enter three-letter CRS codes.
error.invalid_calling_at: Pick a station that RailFeed knows, different from this station.
error.invalid_via: Pick up to 5 stations that RailFeed knows, none of them this station or the 'calling at' station.
error.rate_limited: RailFeed rate limit reached. Try again in a minute.
